_readme: Narrator lines by event. Narrator.say_event(key) picks one at random. {placeholders} get filled in by the game.
heavy_prop: A {prop}? That one is worth {weight}% glitch. Management is sweating.
Please do not drop the {prop}. It is not optimized.
The {prop} was modelled with 4 million polygons. For realism.
low_sanity: Your sanity is at 25%. Please enjoy the complimentary panic.
Sanity low. Have you tried standing still and thinking about puppies?
Management recommends hiding. Hiding is a feature.
death: Please contact management for a refund of dignity.
That puddle is a texture. We are almost sure it is a texture.
Don't worry, the floor is waterproof. It's a feature.
door_flicker: The door is flickering. That is ambiance.
Door rendering at reduced priority. Thank you for your patience.
door_missing_texture: Texture not found? That's called minimalism.
The door is now magenta. Magenta is very in this season.
door_jitter: The door is vibrating with excitement.
Door is z-fighting. Door is winning.
door_gone: Door not found. Please enjoy the open-concept floor plan.
Door failed to render. Walk through it before we notice.
door_back: Door re-rendered. Sorry about that. Everything is fine.
We fixed the door. Please do not break it again.
npc_scared: You scared a monster. That is... not how this works.
lag_start: Lag is an immersive feature. We thank you for your patience.
The frame rate is being artisanal.
boo_seen: They saw you coming. Surprises work better as a surprise.
Nice try. Masks are scarier from behind.
The monster has seen that mask before. It was on sale.
kid_peed: A child has peed. Management did not see anything.
That kid is going home early. Their candy is not.
glitch_crash: House.exe has crashed. Please enjoy the free-roam mode.
bear_trap: A bear trap. In a house. We are not a zoo. We are barely a house.
That was a feature called 'Floor Hug'. Please stop hugging the floor.
Management reminds you: watch your step. The step is watching you.
creaky_board: That floorboard has filed a noise complaint about you.
Loose board. Loose lips. Same thing, really.
key_found: A key! The exit is slightly less locked now.
Key acquired. Keep looking. The house hid the others out of spite.
Another key. Please do not tell the house.
last_key: That was the last key. Something upstairs just woke up. Run.
All keys found. The house has noticed. The house is not happy. RUN.
house_awake: The lights are failing. Something tall is drifting through the walls towards you.
It goes through walls. You do not. Hide, BOO it, or simply leave faster.
door_locked: The exit is locked. Keys are usually in drawers. Usually.
Locked. The door would love to help, but it's union.
search_scare: Something in the drawer was also searching. For you.
